message: Hey team, I accidentally deleted a huge batch of active leads while trying to clean up our contact view. Is there any way to restore them, or did I just lose all that data?
URGENT: Since this morning's update, our team members keep getting logged out automatically every 5 minutes. It's making it impossible for our sales reps to log live calls.
We love the platform, but is there a way to set up automated Slack notifications when an Enterprise deal moves to 'Closed-Won'? Right now we have to check the dashboard manually.
I'm trying to export our monthly contact list into a CSV, but the downloaded file is completely blank. Am I clicking the wrong export button?
The two-way calendar sync with Google Workspace seems broken. Meetings scheduled in the CRM aren't showing up on my Google Calendar, though it worked fine last week.
Would love to see multi-currency support added to the deal pipeline. We're closing contracts in EUR and GBP, but right now everything defaults to USD which messes up our forecasting.
Help! I tried changing my user profile password and now I'm locked out entirely. The password reset email hasn't arrived in my inbox or spam folder.
Our custom reports dashboard is throwing a '504 Gateway Timeout' error every time we try to pull quarterly metrics. This is blocking our leadership review meeting today.
Is there a dark mode version of the web app coming soon? A lot of our support reps work late shifts and the bright white interface is tough on the eyes.
The mobile iOS app keeps crashing immediately upon opening ever since I updated my iPhone to the latest OS version. I've tried reinstalling it twice.
